changelog: - **Names and ids inside a few more sentences are kept in their own direction.** In a right-to-left language the revision chip's tooltip text put the project id, the role and the revision id into the sentence unbounded; laid out left to right, as the chip is, a project id that starts with a digit came apart around the word before it. The frame move and resize announcement written while an arrow key is held carried the frame name unbounded, unlike the one written when the key is released. A failed data import quoted the user's table or frame name unbounded. All three now bound the value, and the two argument checks fail on an argument object they cannot read, unless it is declared with the reason it is safe.
